Title: LSJ: 2 Questions: More Undead Persistance & Wooden Stakes

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
When a vampire plays Undead Persistance, he is prevented from going to
torpor for the moment (long enough to play "not useable by a vampire
going to torpor" effects) and if he is able to successfully use the
optional press, another round of combat begins. If no additional
presses are supplied in the second round, the persistant vampire must
now go to torpor. Can another UP be played to again delay the trip to
torpor?

Would two Ghoul Retainers making use of the same Wooden Stake for the
purposes of a strike satisfy the Wooden Stake's requirement for more
than 1 damage being dealt?

Thanks.

Robert

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Robert Goudie wrote:
>
> When a vampire plays Undead Persistance, he is prevented from going to
> torpor for the moment (long enough to play "not useable by a vampire
> going to torpor" effects) and if he is able to successfully use the
> optional press, another round of combat begins. If no additional
> presses are supplied in the second round, the persistant vampire must
> now go to torpor. Can another UP be played to again delay the trip to
> torpor?

No. The persistent vampire doesn't go to torpor until combat ends.
Since combat has ended, combat cards (like UP) cannot be played.

> Would two Ghoul Retainers making use of the same Wooden Stake for the
> purposes of a strike satisfy the Wooden Stake's requirement for more
> than 1 damage being dealt?

Yes.
